component: small-M affine quantized matmul on simdgroup matrices (sp_qmm), opt-in
modifications: Mechanism mined, code rewritten: the exact bfloat operand 128 + q built by OR-ing the nibble into 0x4300, the 8x8x8 simdgroup_multiply_accumulate on register operands with an fp32 accumulator, the per-group epilogue s * (dot - 128 * sum_x) + b * sum_x, and the lane mapping (fm, fn) of the 8x8 fragment (identical to MLX steel's).

Runs on MLX's own packed layout (no StorageN=256 repack, no prepared activation table): the k order inside each fragment is permuted so each lane reads two 4-element activation runs directly, and group sums come from simd_shuffle_xor instead of a producer-written sums buffer.
Adds 5-bit weights (MLX's little-endian 40-bit chunks; 0x4300 | q is exact for q < 128) and M up to 32 via 8-row M tiles sharing one weight decode.
Deterministic K split across simdgroups of one threadgroup, reduced in fixed order through threadgroup memory, instead of Splash's cross-threadgroup split with arrival counters.
Instance-scoped routing (class swap on selected QuantizedLinear instances, as int8_prefill does) with a measured per-(M, N, bits) policy; default off.
validation: tests/test_sp_qmm.py (CPU: exact emulation of the fragment mapping on MLX-packed 4/5-bit weights, 5-bit unpack, policy, routing, serving switch)
